IN THE DARK
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight

scenes.a: Your tears fell silently into the dark tonight.
scenes.sub: WHEN YOU CRY OUT IN THE DARK

scenes.a: You wondered if anyone heard the grief you could not name.
Hear the scripture of Psalm 88: O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:
Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry.
Lord, in this quiet midnight hour, reach into the room where strength ran out.
Receive the groan that has no words, and hold the heart that spent all day pretending.
Let your presence anchor this weary space until peace arrives. Amen. Your tears fell silently into the dark tonight.
